We’re proud to be a first-tier distributor of over 90% of all maintenance, repair, operating, and production products required for industrial businesses. With the most comprehensive product offering of any other industrial supplier, we give our customers the best value at the best price. See the individual product categories below for more information about each of our offerings.
Quality Products From Top-Rated Brands

DXP is a thriving global distributor of products and services across a wide range of industries . We provide innovative solutions to meet the needs of virtually any scope of work. In our 100 years of business, we’ve served various sectors, including manufacturing, oil and gas, agriculture , transportation, and more. From metal working and rotating equipment to safety and industrial supplies , we have the products you need to get the job done.

Industrial customers across the world count on DXP to deliver the highest quality products. That’s why we work with only the most trusted manufacturers—because we demand the best for our customers. Our extensive product range, strong supplier relationships, substantial purchasing power , and vast global network allow us to meet every customer’s unique needs. And when you need assistance, our trusted product experts are always available to help you select the right solution for your application. Contact a DXP team member today .
Our DXPeople are the heart of our organization. DXPeople are dedicated to helping our customers meet their goals. ​

We are a close-knit family, and we combine a national distribution network with customer-first hospitality. The values of our DXPeople shine-through in each interaction in the field. We are driven by problem solving for the customer and providing the “Xpertise” and service you rely upon.​

From rotating equipment, to metal working or bearing and power transmission, the products we represent are highly technical. We pride ourselves on having, not only access to first-tier products, but experts to make product recommendations and to service your equipment when the need arises. At DXP, we have a strong dedication to quality customer service, products, product distribution, and the technical services we perform.

We understand the importance of having a good foundation in setting the standard for success. At DXP, we are committed to maintaining sound governance and ethical business practices while striving to achieve customer-driven solutions. We believe in building deep, solution-oriented relationships with our customers through internal and external business growth.

raw_blocks: For more than 100 years, DXP Enterprises has served as a leading industrial distribution expert in the industry. Product specialties include rotating equipment , bearings and power transmission , metalworking , industrial supplies and more. Our company continues to stay on the leading edge of technology , training, and products while attracting and retaining the best employees. From aviation and agriculture to fabrication and construction , we offer dedicated service and support for a variety of industries .

At DXP, our corporate strategy is simply to be the best solution for our industrial customers. Our team is comprised of customer-driven experts in a variety of specialties, including supply chain services , pump manufacturing , and renewable energy solutions . In the best interest of our clients and partners, we maintain compliance of all statutory and regulatory requirements. DXP is committed to providing quality products and services that exceed our customer’s expectations.

At the center of our approach to corporate responsibility, DXP is committed to delivering transparency, both in our own operations and on behalf of our customers. We firmly believe that the power of active decision-making is the best way to achieve consistent and reliable sustainability. Our robust Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) Strategy will allow us to drive improvements wherever and whenever possible, all while serving our clients and protecting the environment. As we actively work internally and externally to meet ESG reporting standards, we encourage you to do the same. Learn more about our commitment to corporate sustainability.
